text:
ana: Quick sync — we need final launch criteria for SOC2/ISO readiness + retention playbook. Several enterprise customers asked about per-tenant legal hold + cross-region retention windows. Can product, eng, legal align on gating?

matt: +1. Short list I care about: 1) evidence export format stable, 2) immutable audit logs with HMAC, 3) retention policy per-region, 4) BYOK handshake not blocking export.

jordan: For eng: we can do per-tenant retention flags, but cost + indexing impact. Need decision on max retention tiers (30/90/365/indef) and whether 'indef' requires special storage.

sofia: Legal: 'indef' must include legal-hold escape hatch & export SLA. Also need chain-of-custody metadata in exports (requestor, time, approval id).

lee: Ops/SRE: rollout constraints: index growth will kill query SLA if we keep hot indexes for >90d. Propose cold-archive with on-demand rehydrate + 48h export SLA.

ana: product ask: define launch criteria (must-have) vs post-launch (nice-to-have). My proposal: must-have = SOC2 evidence exports v1, per-tenant retention toggle (30/90/365), audit log integrity + search for 90d, BYOK support for key wrapping; post-launch = 'indef' retention + on-prem export flow. Thoughts?

matt: sounds reasonable. Add must-have: role-based export authorization & audit trail for exports.

jordan: Implementation notes: per-tenant toggle = small feature; 'indef' requires legal & ops agreement and maybe separate billing. For BYOK, handshake v1 = metadata-only (no key escrow).

sofia: Confirming: exports must include chain-of-custody fields. Also require data-subject deletion path documented for GDPR.

ana: timeline? Product would like canary by end of Q2, GA by mid-Q3.

lee: Q2 canary ok if we scope must-haves tightly. Need ticket for indexing changes + retention worker.

matt: I'll create RFC for export format & auth. tagging me @matt

compliance-bot: New checklist created: /checklists/soc2_iso_readiness_v3 — contains 'must-have' items and owners. :white_check_mark:

ana: Thanks — let's triage in next week's roadmap meeting. I'll post owners and acceptance criteria to the checklist before then. :thumbsup:
